alignments.note: Postpositive γάρ fronted as English For.
Outer article in attributive position governing υἱός across the interposed genitive τοῦ θεοῦ (rule 57); it takes the English the, exactly as ὁ τοῦ κόσμου ἄρχων → the prince of the world does.
Head noun left bare, its determiner standing on the article (rule 57); rule 51's supplied-determiner clause does not reach a noun standing behind its own article.
The ASV gives θεοῦ no determiner, so the article has no the to anchor; rule 23 empties it and rule 21 keeps the case preposition on the noun. Rule 57's closing clause names this case.
Source noun rendered of + noun; rule 17 heads on God.
Names split separately under rules 26 and 28.

Second attributive article of an expressed head noun υἱός with a participle following; rule 31's τῷ θεῷ τῷ κτίσαντι test gives the relativizer to the participle and leaves the article realizing nothing. Rule 31's prepositional-phrase carve-out does not apply, the ἐν ὑμῖν and δι᾽ ἡμῶν phrases standing inside the participial clause rather than being the article's own modifier; rule 90 blesses no unit in which a head noun is expressed.
Attributive participle rendered as a finite relative clause; who and was are rule 7 and 9 helpers, headed on the lexical verb (rule 17).

Agentive διά realized by *by*, with the supplied appositional *even* riding as a rule 7 helper on the preposition it introduces; rule 11 keeps the ASV italics from making it `added`, and rule 17 heads the unit on the prepositional word. The corpus folds a supplied *even* onto an expressed preposition in every one of its four such units — GAL.1.15 ἐκ → *even from* and 2CO.10.16 εἰς → *even unto*, both unhedged, and 1JN.5.20 and GAL.5.14 ἐν → *even in* — and marks none of them `added`; 1JN.5.20 and GAL.5.14 are this same repeated-preposition apposition, and 1JN.5.20's note records that the `added` convention it departs from is article-specific. Every `added` bare *even* in the corpus stands where no preposition introduces the appositive. Medium: the corpus is divided overall on a supplied appositional *even*, as 1JN.5.20 records.
γίνομαι rendered by the copular was; the negative stands on its own token.
Ordinary negative aligned to not; no negative indefinite and no quantifier is in question, so rules 41, 59 and 87 do not apply.
The ASV spreads ἐν αὐτῷ over separate words, so rules 81 and 94 are not in question and the ordinary split applies.
Perfect γέγονεν rendered by the present is.
Predicate Ναί following the verb in the ASV's order; rule 15 permits the reordering.

review_notes: Returned unchanged. All 29 source and 31 target IDs are partitioned exactly once, every aligned unit has nonempty arrays with member heads, and the two unrepresented units carry valid source heads and null target heads.

s001/s002: rule 57 is decisive and is why the two articles part company. The outer ὁ governs υἱός across the interposed genitive and takes the English the; the inner τοῦ stands before its own head noun θεοῦ, for which the ASV writes no determiner, so rule 23 empties it and rule 21 leaves of on the noun. Do not read the inner article as owed a bare of.

s008 is the second attributive article of an expressed head noun with a participle after it, which is rule 31's τῷ θεῷ τῷ κτίσαντι case rather than rule 32's or rule 90's substantival one; who therefore rides with κηρυχθείς and the article realizes nothing. The prepositional phrases ἐν ὑμῖν and δι᾽ ἡμῶν sit inside the participial clause, so rule 31's prepositional-phrase carve-out — which would have kept the relativizer on the article — is not triggered.

t015 even is the one genuinely open unit, and it is the only hedge in the verse. It is added because no source token is left to license it: the appositional δι᾽ ἐμοῦ has its own by, and both καί tokens are already spent on and, so rule 82's supplied-even clause has no correlative to attach to. Rule 88's four legitimate added junctures include REV.15.6, a juncture between adjectives, which is the nearest shape; the competing reading, a rule 7 helper on δι᾽ ἐμοῦ headed on by, is recorded in the unit note.
Rule 12 was respected: the two recorded variants (v020 underdetermined, v021 selected, both to r00-base) are taken as given by the projection and no textual decision was made inside the alignment.
